title: "Gaze of the Chess Player"
next_chapter_hook: "At the moment Chen Ji was about to speak, the entire simulation space suddenly solidified—a fourth figure he had never foreseen was slowly walking forth from the end of the timeline."

text.content:
"Before Mo Xiansheng's exclamation had even faded, a vast and boundless will surged into the Mental Sea like a tide. This was not any known pressure, but a presence far more ancient and indifferent—as if the entire heavens and earth had opened their eyes at this moment, gazing upon the most restless piece on their chessboard.

Chen Ji felt his body sink, and the three envoys' figures before him abruptly blurred, replaced by an endless expanse of Void."

"'Interesting.'

A voice came from all directions, devoid of any emotional波动, yet causing Chen Ji's Tianji Record Fragment to involuntarily tremble violently. That voice seemed to resound in the depths of his soul, each word carrying irresistible weight.

'Throughout the ages, seers have either died from Heavenly Fate backlash or become puppets of Heavenly Dao... Only you dare to lay such an intricate chess game before me.'"

dialogue.content: "'Since that is the case, I shall personally witness—whether you, Chen Ji, possess the qualification to become a Chess Player, rather than a piece.'"

text.content:
"The moment the words fell, countless points of light suddenly emerged within the Void, each one a history yet to unfold. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—he saw the scene of Tianqing Sect's destruction, saw the Demon Path Saint Ye Qing lying in a pool of blood, saw Su Qingyao standing alone atop the ruins.

Three vastly different endings, three threads of fate he had personally calculated."

choice.prompt: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao displayed the three fate threads nakedly before Chen Ji, awaiting his choice."

choices.description: "Destroy Heavenly Dao's control over fate, so that there are no more seers in the world, so that the Tianji Record vanishes completely. The price is losing all established connections, dying alone."
choices.visible_reward: "Heavenly Dao crumbles, all beings are free"

text.content:
"The points of light converged into a silver-white river of fate. Chen Ji saw himself on that path—white-haired, blind, standing atop an unnamed mountain peak, overlooking a world no longer bound by the Tianji Record.

Alone, yet utterly free."

choices.description: "Devour the will of Heavenly Dao and become the new Chess Player. The price is complete corruption, annihilation of humanity, becoming the next cold Heavenly Dao."
choices.risk_hint: "You will become the existence you despise most"

text.content:
"The points of light converged into a pitch-black river of fate. Chen Ji saw himself on that path—body wrapped in golden Heavenly Dao laws, eyes hollow as an abyss, coldly gazing at the ants beneath his feet.

Powerful, yet no longer human."

choices.description: "Neither destroy nor devour—seek a road even Heavenly Dao has not foreseen. Risks unknown, price unknown, but perhaps... the only way out."
choices.risk_hint: "This is a path no one has ever walked"

text.content:
"The points of light suddenly scattered, becoming a mist of chaos. Chen Ji tried to see that path, only to find all his foresight growing blurred within the mist—

As if some force was deliberately concealing that road's existence."

"'Three paths, three endings.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of playfulness. 'Throughout the ages, seers have wandered among these three paths, ultimately meeting destruction. And you, Chen Ji—I am curious, how will you choose?'

Chen Ji stood in the Void, his gaze sweeping across the three rivers of fate. His Tianji Record Fragment still trembled, yet no longer from fear, but from some strange resonance."

dialogue.content: "'Senior Heavenly Dao.' Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile calm to the point of mockery. 'Are you certain... this is giving me a choice?'"

text.content:
"The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao fluctuated slightly, seemingly surprised by this address.

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze fixed on the depths of that chaotic Void: 'You said that throughout the ages, seers have wandered among these three paths—because they had no other road to take. But I am different.'

His voice was soft, yet carried unshakeable certainty: 'I have a sister, have friends, have allies willing to die for me. I am not a wretched creature playing chess against Heavenly Dao alone.'"

"At that moment, a faint yet clear voice rang out from the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—

'Brother...'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. That voice did not come from the Tianji Record, not from Mo Xiansheng, but from his sister who had been missing for years—Chen Nian.

'Brother, I'm here... I can feel you...'

Chen Nian's voice was fragmented, yet carried unprecedented determination: 'Don't choose those three paths... they're all traps... there's a fourth path...'"

dialogue.content: "'A fourth path?' Chen Ji lowered his voice, urgently asking within his heart, 'Nian'er, where are you? Are you safe?'"

text.content:
"Chen Nian's voice rang out again, though with a hint of pain: 'I... I'm not sure... They locked me in a very strange place... There are mirrors everywhere, I can see many things, but can't speak...'

Her voice grew increasingly faint, as if some force was blocking her consciousness: 'Brother, the core of the Tianji Record... it's not with Heavenly Dao... it's with you...'

Before the words finished, the connection completely severed."

choice.prompt:
"Chen Nian's awakening brought new information—the core of the Tianji Record lies within Chen Ji himself.
The Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to sense something, and the chessboard of fate began accelerating its operation."

choices.description: "Ignore the three paths offered by Heavenly Dao, attempt to activate the core of the Tianji Record. The risk is extremely high, but perhaps a true way out can be found."
choices.visible_reward: "Reveal the Truth of the Tianji Record"
choices.risk_hint: "You are betting that Heavenly Dao hasn't fully seen through you"

text.content:
"Chen Ji closed his eyes, no longer looking at the three rivers of fate. His consciousness sank inward, descending to the deepest part of the Mental Sea—where the Tianji Record Fragment was emitting a faint golden glow.

'Mr. Mo.' he called in his heart. 'What exactly is the core of the Tianji Record?'

After a moment of silence, Mo Xiansheng's voice finally sounded, yet carried unprecedented solemnity: 'Young one, are you certain you want to know? Some truths, once known, can never be undone.'"

dialogue.content: "'I never look back.' Chen Ji's voice was resolute."

text.content:
"Mo Xiansheng let out a long sigh: 'The core of the Tianji Record... is yourself. Every choice you make, every move in your chess game, every obsession—all are shaping it. The so-called fragments are merely the parts it chose to let you see.'

'And the true, complete Tianji Record...' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor, 'requires you to write it yourself.'"

"At that moment, the entire simulation space violently quaked. The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao swept through like a storm, carrying suppressed fury: 'Chen Ji! How dare you—'

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, golden light blazing in his pupils. In that instant, he saw—beyond the three rivers of fate, a silver band of light that had never existed was slowly taking shape.

That was the fourth path.

That was an existence even Heavenly Dao could not foresee."

choices.text: "Wait for the Moment · Submit to Heaven's Will"
choices.description: "Pretend to accept Heavenly Dao's arrangement while secretly seeking clues to the fourth path. This is the most prudent approach, but will cause Chen Nian to bear more risks alone."
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Dao will not give you much time"

text.content:
"Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the excitement in his heart. He raised his head, his gaze returning to the three rivers of fate, his expression becoming utterly calm.

'Senior Heavenly Dao.' his voice carried no trace of波纹, 'This junior needs time to consider.'

The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao remained silent for a moment, seemingly examining his sincerity. After a long while, that vast pressure slowly receded.

'Three days.' Heavenly Dao's voice was devoid of emotion. 'In three days, I want your answer.'"

"The simulation space suddenly dissolved, and Chen Ji found himself standing once more in the Council Hall of Tianqing Sect. The three envoys remained in their frozen postures, as if everything just now had been merely an illusion.

But he knew it was not.

The temperature of the Tianji Record Fragment told him everything was real. And now, in the depths of his Mental Sea, Chen Nian's voice sounded again, carrying exhaustion and worry: 'Brother... Are you alright? I feel so tired...'

'I'm fine.' Chen Ji responded softly in his heart. 'Nian'er, take care of yourself. Big Brother will definitely come save you.'

'Mm...' Chen Nian's voice grew weaker, 'I believe in you...'"

"The instant the connection completely severed, Chen Ji felt the pure determination lingering in his sister's consciousness. That trust was so genuine, unmingled with any calculation, containing only a sister's most instinctive dependence on her brother.

In the Council Hall, Su Qingyao's voice suddenly rang out: 'Chen Ji? Your complexion is terrible, what happened?'

Chen Ji raised his head, the corner of his mouth curving into a faint arc—that was the gentleness that only appeared when facing his closest ones: 'Nothing. Just... suddenly really want to win.'

Three days.

He had to find that nonexistent path within three days."

"The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed to solidify at this moment.

It gazed at that forming silver band of light, a rare flicker passing through its eyes—not anger, but... confusion?

'Impossible...' Heavenly Dao's voice showed the first signs of wavering. 'How did you achieve this? Your foresight spans only three hours, how could you see something even I cannot?'

Chen Ji faced that vast gaze, his lips slowly curving upward: 'Because you are too accustomed to being a Chess Player, forgetting the most important thing—'

He extended his hand, pointing to that silver river of fate, his voice light yet clear: 'Sometimes, the piece itself can become the chessboard.'"

dialogue.content: "'What do you mean?' Heavenly Dao's voice turned cold and sharp, an invisible pressure bearing down on Chen Ji like a mountain."

text.content:
"Chen Ji did not answer, merely gazing quietly at that silver band of light. Within that light, he saw a vague figure beckoning to him—another self, yet not entirely the same.

That figure had the same face as him, yet wore entirely different robes. Golden Heavenly Dao laws coiled around its body, but its eyes were as clear as a newborn infant's.

He was both Heavenly Dao and himself.

He was both the piece and the chessboard.

Chen Ji suddenly understood the truth of the fourth path—not to destroy Heavenly Dao, not to replace Heavenly Dao, but to merge with Heavenly Dao, so that Chess Player and piece no longer stood in opposition."

dialogue.content: "'Senior Heavenly Dao.' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice calm to the point of sanctity. 'You have been searching for an existence to inherit your will, have you not?'"

text.content:
"The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao fluctuated again, as if pricked by some hidden wound.

Chen Ji continued: 'You used the seers throughout the ages as pieces, because you could not find an existence who could stand as your equal. You are too powerful, too ancient, powerful enough that no one could understand your loneliness.'

He paused, his gaze fixed on that Void: 'But I am different. I can scheme, can calculate, can weave an unbreakable game right under your nose—but I can also love, can trust, can become enemies with all of Heavenly Dao for the sake of a insignificant little sister.'

'Isn't this what you truly want?' Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of sharpness. 'An existence with both the wisdom of a Chess Player and the warmth of a piece. An existence that could free you from loneliness.'"

"A long silence.

The three rivers of fate within the simulation space began slowly dissolving, while that silver band of light grew increasingly clear. The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao hovered in the Void, seemingly engaged in some intense inner struggle.

'You are very clever.' After a long while, Heavenly Dao's voice sounded again, no longer cold but carrying a complex sigh. 'More clever than any seer throughout the ages.'

'But no one has ever walked this path. Are you certain you wish to proceed?'

Chen Ji stepped forward without hesitation, stepping into that silver river of fate: 'I never walk the paths others have walked.'"

"Silver light erupted abruptly, completely engulfing Chen Ji's figure.

Within that light, he felt unprecedented power flooding into his body—Heavenly Dao's power, yet no longer opposing or suppressing, but gentle and resonant.

The Tianji Record Fragment quivered violently within the Mental Sea, page after page of sealed chapters slowly unfurling. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul cried out in amazement: 'This is... the complete Tianji Record! You actually did it!'

And just then, Chen Nian's voice sounded again, no longer weak but clear and resolute: 'Brother! I can feel it... I can see you now!'

Within Chen Ji's perception, his sister's consciousness was resonating with Heavenly Dao's power in some way. She was no longer merely a 'Heavenly Fate Lock,' but was awakening her own independent will."

dialogue.content: "'Nian'er!' Chen Ji urgently called in his heart, 'Are you alright? Did they hurt you?'"

text.content:
"Chen Nian's voice carried unprecedented vitality: 'I'm fine, Brother... No, I should say, I've never felt this good. Those mirrors trapping me... I can feel them starting to crack.'

Her voice carried a hint of excitement: 'I can feel you, feel the Tianji Record... even feel that terrifying existence. But I'm not afraid anymore. Because you're not fighting alone.'

Chen Ji suddenly felt a warm force surge from the depths of his Mental Sea—that was Chen Nian's consciousness resonating with his. Two threads of fate that should have interfered with each other, now miraculously intertwining, forming an even more brilliant silver-gold band of light."

"'Is this the fourth path...' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, no longer purely cold but carrying an indescribable complexity, 'replacing fate control with fate resonance... interesting, very interesting.'

The simulation space began slowly dissolving, the three envoys' figures becoming clear again. But the Chen Ji at this moment was no longer the废物 disciple struggling to survive moments ago—silver light faintly encircled his body, golden Heavenly Dao laws flickered in the depths of his pupils, his entire being seeming reborn.

Su Qingyao was the first to notice the abnormality, her gaze locked死死 on Chen Ji, her voice carrying disbelief: 'Chen Ji... your aura, how did it...'?

Chen Ji turned to her, giving her a meaningful smile: 'Senior Sister Su, three days have passed, hope you've been well.'

—Next chapter coming soon—In the shocked gazes of the three envoys, the will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao completely retreated, replaced by a new figure Chen Ji had never foreseen: Cang Yutian's true body had finally appeared."
